'''Hola Paskalian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the head of security for [[Pakkerd Light Transport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ession]]. She was a supporter of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and was recommended by Zsinj to succeed [[Vanter Raffin]] as the chief officer when he retired.
